_doc: Tanks, the drive, the gun and the station energy models (brief 2.2, 2.4). Owner: rules. Schema: TankContentSchema.validate_tanks. Units: art px, game metres, seconds, joules of P_eff, % FTP. G1 tuning against the brief (balance probe, TankRig sessions of every crew; details in docs/decisions/tank.md): hull.hp 120 (brief 100), dynamo.stabilizer_per_s 2.0 (1.5), steam.full_j 4500 (6000), gearbox.hoist_j 3500 (4000), gearbox.auto_drive_clear_px 340 (300: a medium holds up to 340 px, so 300 left it unengaged). G2 balance iteration 1 (docs/decisions/tank.md Balance iteration 1): Bulwark enemy_scale 0.75 (0.6), hull.hp 140 (100), hull.checkpoint_hp 30 (20), drive.evasive_hit_mult 0.5 (0.7), dynamo.stabilizer_per_s back to the brief 1.5, dynamo.hoist_s [22, 11] ([20, 10]), gearbox.hoist_j back to the brief 4000. v2 contracts (docs/decisions/tank.md 2026-10-27 v2 contract): the Bastion (crew 4); the Citadel's rooms in the reference's order rear to front (diesel, steam, dynamo; the slot-to-engine map is stations.json start_engines) and only its main turret (bow guns replace the secondaries); the Bastion's hull_px from assets/tank/v2/kit.json in rules px (art px / 1.5, rounded): width tank.variants.tank_4rider.hull_length_px 491 / 1.5 = 327, height 71 = (road_wheel_line.ground_contact_y 233 - the hull roof row 127 of hull_3rider.png) / 1.5 (one vertical framing for every variant); the kit's sizes for the other tanks (Bulwark [220, 71], Rampart [251, 71], Citadel [296, 71]) wait for the v2 view, since the v1 view and its rigs.json are built on [192, 72], [240, 76] and [288, 80]; power_ratio: the target % FTP of SIM phases without an ERG target (TankRules.target_pct). Added keys: ram.prompt_px (a light tank this near shows the Surge to ram prompt), props (obstacle sizes, light_hits_to_clear, standoff_px: a barricade stops the tank this far short because the gun cannot depress onto anything nearer than about 230 px), drill.wreck_px (the aim drill's wrecks, px ahead of the halted hull).

evade._doc: Surge to evade (brief 2.4): a telegraphed shot misses when a rider who can evade (a SIM WORK phase of their own plan, past its first 300 s) holds the sprint rule (the trailing sprint_window_s average >= 1.2 x FTP raw, BRIEF 3.5) for hold_s inside the telegraph, boss_hold_s for the Behemoth's main gun. v1's ram block, reduced to what evade needs.

power_ratio._doc: TankRiderState.target_pct where no ERG target applies (brief 2.3 In band): the diesel and the Bulwark use the middle of in_band.sim_ftp_pct, the building steam engine TankConst.STEAM_BUILD_PCT; these are the rest.

bow._doc: The bow guns (brief 2.4 Gun), two short guns in the nose on every tank: a damage burst (one SHELL_BOW round, both guns) every every_s at the nearest enemy (or Behemoth part) ahead whose near edge is min_px..max_px off the hull front, else a wire or wreck there (clear_s of fire clears it). Armour: enemies.json light_mult (mediums 0.5; heavies, destroyers, the Behemoth 0.25). Power: the Bastion's arc generator (full rate in band, under_band_rate under band, none on reserve or stalled), the Rampart's and the Citadel's dynamo bank (per_burst_units a burst, none below min_bank, none stalled), the Bulwark's gearbox (bulwark_rate, free).

arc._doc: The arc generator (brief 2.4): while its rider is in band the searchlights are lit and the main gun's dispersion is multiplied by lit_dispersion_mult.
